notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Aphetto Alchemist.
Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.
